info.title: Instagram Android — extracted API evidence
info.description: Static reconstruction from the installed Android client. Configure your session below, then use Try it out or the manual request editor. Method badges reflect recovered request configuration, not successful live execution. Unknown-method routes and GraphQL/Bloks names appear below on this page. Payloads remain partial; generic editors do not imply a recovered schema. The local proxy adds /api/v1 to relative routes unless an explicit API, GraphQL or upload prefix is present. No account action runs until you execute a request.
